text:
tariq: repro note - hitting sporadic JSON.parse failures in the Next.js sample when token rotation happens mid-stream. Happens with EventSource polyfill.

anis: hosted or private? SDK version?

tariq: hosted staging. JS SDK 2.4.1, sample-app pinned polyfill. If I rotate the token at ~30s into a long stream, sometimes parse throws.

olivia: got any raw SSE frames? looks like a reassembly problem.

tariq: here's a trimmed capture from network/session logs: 

```
data: {"msg":"m1","chunk":"hello wo"}
data: {"msg":"m1","chunk":"rld"}

data: {"msg":"m2","chunk":"alpha"}
```

but when refresh happens I sometimes see: 

```
data: {"msg":"m1","chunk":"hello "}
data: {"msg":"m2","chunk":"alpha"}
data: {"msg":"m1","chunk":"world"}
```

which the client emits as m2 then a broken m1 concat -> JSON.parse fails.

anis: do we emit resume-token or last-event-id on reconnect? we added resume-token a bit ago.

tariq: server sets resume-token, yes. polyfill can open new ES while old one is still closing, there's ~150-250ms overlap. Both sockets push events and the client handler gets interleaved chunks. Also saw a cached-fragment replay from the polyfill in one case.

sam: two approaches: client gating (wait for 'close' before new open) or server add per-fragment metadata so SDKs can reassemble. Which do you prefer for fast fix?

tariq: client guard is quick. I added a small change to sample-app that waits for close or times out after 1s and that removed my local repro. But staging still shows some failures for a small subset.

olivia: long-term we should add a fragment sequence id (frag_seq) and a stream-level message id so SDKs can reorder and detect gaps. SDK should also buffer incomplete fragments until boundary or sequence advance.

anis: agree. plan: 1) short-term: ship JS SDK open/close guard and update sample-app onboarding note; 2) mid-term: infra to add frag_seq + stable last_event_id resume semantics; 3) tests: e2e harness that drives token rotation with variable overlap (0-500ms) and random chunk ordering; 4) telemetry: log parse errors with resume-token and polyfill version.

sam: I'll wire a proxy-based stress test that injects overlaps and reorders packets so we can validate buffering logic.

ci-bot: ci: sample-app patch + sdk v2.4.2-alpha with close-guard pushed to staging.

tariq: filed issues: devex#621 (js-sdk close-guard), infra#341 (sse frag_seq header), e2e#198 (auth-rotate-harness). Adding follow-up PRs for tests and changelog.

olivia: small SDK note: buffer size cap + time-based flush needed to avoid indefinite buffering if fragments drop. We'll spec a reconcilation strategy: use frag_seq gaps to request re-send or fallback to new message id.

anis: add unit tests that feed the parser partial JSON strings and out-of-order fragment events for all SDK languages.

tariq: thanks all. i'll attach the minimal node repro in the issue: quick script that opens EventSource, logs parse errors, and triggers a simulated token rotate via /auth/rotate endpoint.

sam: once infra adds frag_seq we'll update all SDKs to prefer reassembly over client gating. Until then, recommend sample-app docs: "Avoid rotating tokens mid-stream; if necessary, wait for SSE close or use short-lived streams."

tariq: marking this resolved for now pending infra#341. will follow up if staging errors spike. :thumbsup:
